security_audit.summary: The skill is a React Native and Expo troubleshooting guide with no evidence of prompt injection, covert data collection, or unauthorized network activity. Several documented commands can delete caches or simulator data, alter builds, install packages, or terminate processes; users should review them before execution.

remediation.issue: Destructive cleanup commands are presented without scope checks.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for confirmation before deleting dependencies, temporary directories, simulator data, or build artifacts, and explain the affected scope.

remediation.issue: The port cleanup command uses forceful process termination.
remediation.suggestion: Show the target process and request confirmation before using kill -9; prefer graceful termination when possible.

remediation.issue: The guide recommends a global package installation.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a project-local or npx invocation and tell users to review the package source before installation.

content.value_statement: Mobile issues can span Metro, native tooling, emulators, and application code. This skill provides structured checks and targeted commands for React Native and Expo debugging.
actual_capabilities: Suggest cache-reset steps for Metro bundler failures.
Guide investigation of iOS pods, Android builds, and Expo prebuild issues.
Identify commands for viewing iOS and Android device logs.
Provide a React hook example for identifying slow component renders.
Explain common JavaScript, native, dependency, and network error patterns.
Provide a repeatable checklist for reproducing mobile application failures.
limitations: It does not execute commands or inspect an application unless the host agent is given access.
It does not diagnose proprietary crash reports without supplied logs and context.
Some commands can remove local caches, build artifacts, simulator data, or processes.
It focuses on React Native and Expo rather than native-only mobile applications.

use_cases.title: Restore a failing Metro build
use_cases.description: Clear relevant caches and check dependencies when the bundler cannot resolve modules.

use_cases.title: Investigate device-only crashes
use_cases.description: Collect iOS or Android logs and compare native error details with recent changes.

use_cases.title: Find rendering regressions
use_cases.description: Add focused render-time logging to identify components exceeding a frame budget.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Metro investigation
prompt_templates.prompt: My React Native app cannot resolve a module. Give me the safest Metro troubleshooting steps and explain which commands change files.

prompt_templates.title: Review a native build error
prompt_templates.prompt: My Android React Native build fails after adding a native module. Help me interpret the error and propose checks before cleaning build artifacts.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze slow rendering
prompt_templates.prompt: My Expo screen feels slow. Show how to measure render duration, identify likely rerender causes, and propose a validation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Create a cross-platform debug plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a step-by-step plan to diagnose a crash that occurs only on Android release builds. Include logs to collect, hypotheses, and safe rollback steps.

output_examples.input: Metro reports an unresolved module after a dependency update.
output: Check the import path and installed dependency first.
Stop Metro, clear the relevant cache, then reinstall dependencies only after confirming the project state.
Restart the bundler and verify the error no longer occurs.

output_examples.input: A React Native screen drops frames during scrolling.
output: Add render-time logging to the affected component.
Compare render duration with a 16 ms frame budget.
Inspect subscriptions, timers, and props that can trigger unnecessary rerenders.

output_examples.input: An Android device crash has no visible JavaScript error.
output: Collect Logcat output while reproducing the crash.
Check for Java exceptions and native module compatibility.
Compare the failing device, build type, and recent dependency changes.

best_practices: Reproduce the issue and save the full error before running cleanup commands.
Confirm the target project, device, port, and data scope before executing destructive commands.
Change one variable at a time and verify the result after each step.
anti_patterns: Do not delete simulator data or project dependencies before collecting error details.
Do not use forceful process termination without confirming the process and port.
Do not treat device logs as complete evidence without checking build type and environment.

faq.question: Which frameworks does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers React Native and Expo troubleshooting workflows.

faq.question: Can it fix Metro bundler errors?
faq.answer: It provides checks and cache-reset guidance for common Metro failures.

faq.question: Does it support Android debugging?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Android build, ADB, and Logcat troubleshooting guidance.

faq.question: Does it support iOS debugging?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes pod, simulator, and Xcode console guidance.

faq.question: Will it delete my files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents commands, but you should review and confirm destructive commands before running them.

faq.question: Can it diagnose a crash without logs?
faq.answer: It can suggest an investigation plan, but logs and reproduction steps improve the diagnosis.
